description: This file defines the LocationModel class used in the OrangeHRM system to represent Location entities within the admin service model layer. It implements the Normalizable interface and uses traits for serialization; it primarily sets up attributes and filters for Location objects.

classes.name: LocationModel
classes.description: Model class for Location entities in OrangeHRM, implementing serialization and normalization.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LocationModel with a Location entity, setting filters and attribute names.
